assertion.description: A phase 3 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of pegcetacoplan, a C3-level complement inhibitor, in primary cold agglutinin disease, completed with 24 participants. selected_evidence.snippet: Prospective, non-randomized multicenter study on the safety and efficacy of combination therapy with bendamustine and rituximab for chronic cold agglutinin disease.

assertion.name: NCT01303952
assertion.description: DECADE, an open-label prospective bicentric non-randomized phase 2 trial of the anti-C5 antibody eculizumab in chronic cold agglutinin disease.
